analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read occurs when check_assertion_avtab_match indexes p->attr_type_map with k->source_type - 1 / k->target_type - 1 without validating that source_type/target_type are within 1..p->p_types.nprim. A malformed policy can produce an avtab entry with type value 0, so the expression becomes -1 and ebitmap_match_any reads an ebitmap_t just before the allocated attr_type_map array (crash seen at ebitmap.c:232 reading e2->node). Crash site is ebitmap_match_any, but root cause is missing bounds/validity checks in check_assertion_avtab_match before dereferencing attr_type_map.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input must build a policy where neverallow checking runs (cil_check_neverallow -> check_assertion -> avtab_map -> check_assertion_avtab_match) and an avtab rule has invalid source_type or target_type (notably 0). During matching, check_assertion_avtab_match uses that invalid type ID to index attr_type_map, creating an out-of-bounds pointer passed into ebitmap_match_any, which then dereferences e2->node and triggers ASan heap-buffer-overflow read.
